scripts.build:www: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp -R vendor www/vendor
scripts.apk: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=/usr/local/opt/openjdk@21 ANDROID_HOME=/usr/local/share/android-commandlinetools ./gradlew assembleDebug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../MCNote-V3.apk
scripts.ios: npm run build:www && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:ipad: npm run ios && cd ios/App && rm -rf build-neuf && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination "id=00008027-001C25E02205802E" -allowProvisioningUpdates -derivedDataPath build-neuf build; xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008027-001C25E02205802E build-neuf/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/App.app && xcrun devicectl device process launch --device 00008027-001C25E02205802E app.mcnote.v3
